sources.title: Edwin Torres — RIT Directory
sources.author: Rochester Institute of Technology
sources.content: Edwin Torres studies consumer behavior, services marketing, human resources, and hospitality, and teaches introductory hospitality and tourism management.

sources.title: Saunders department chair brings ardor for hospitality and research
sources.author: Rochester Institute of Technology
sources.content: Torres's research includes customer delight and outrage, service quality, electronic word of mouth, and human-resource topics in hospitality.
